subject.title: Expose structured progress metrics in hook events for plugin-based live progress cards

question: Should OpenClaw add optional producer-owned progress metrics to before_tool_call, after_tool_call, and agent_end, and what source of truth should define step totals, percent, ETA, and terminal states?
rationale: This is feasible as an additive Plugin SDK change, but automation should not choose public progress semantics that could make plugin live cards show misleading completion state.

options.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
options.body: Add optional metrics only where a producer has authoritative progress facts, document absent unknowns, and cover each producer with focused tests.

options.title: Use a separate progress event
options.body: Create a dedicated progress hook/event so tool and terminal hooks remain unchanged and progress can evolve independently.

options.title: Keep current hooks unchanged
options.body: Leave plugins to render phase/status progress from existing hook events until a stronger runtime progress model exists.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow metrics contract
recommendation.body: Add optional metrics only where a producer has authoritative progress facts, document absent unknowns, and cover each producer with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is ownership of the public hook contract type surface and recent hook context evolution.
